outline.label: Outline
outline.description: A thin line around the orb, and around ball and card together when the card is out.

bar_size.label: Size in the bar
bar_size.description: Orb diameter in the bar, in pixels.

orb_size.label: Size out of the bar
orb_size.description: Orb diameter when it is out, in pixels.

card_horizontal.label: Card opens toward
card_horizontal.description: Auto picks the side with room.

remember_position.label: Remember where it was put
remember_position.description: When it comes out, it goes back to where you last put it down.

follow_speed.label: Follow
follow_speed.description: How closely it trails your cursor while it follows.

animation_speed.label: Animation speed
animation_speed.description: Dripping out, diving in, the card opening and closing.

hermes_url.label: Hermes server
hermes_url.description: Address of the machine running Hermes (no port), e.g. your Tailscale name.

hermes_api_port.label: Hermes API port
hermes_api_port.description: Port of Hermes' API server (API_SERVER_PORT). The key comes from your keyring: secret-tool store service orb-hermes kind api-key

reset.label: Reset everything to defaults
reset.description: Turn on to put every Orb setting back to its default. The plugin reloads and this switch turns itself back off.

double_click_ms.label: Double-click speed (ms)
double_click_ms.description: How quickly two clicks must follow to pick it up. A single click waits this long before it opens the card.

home_position.label: Home position (%)
home_position.description: Where along the bar the orb dives in and out, as a percentage of the bar length. 0 guesses from the widget's place in the bar.

card_color.label: Card color
card_color.description: The card's background. Pick a surface color (surface, surface_variant): replies use your theme's text color.

hermes_ssh.label: SSH login
hermes_ssh.description: user@host on the Hermes server. Files that are not images travel over SSH: attachments to ~/orb-inbox, files Hermes sends you to ~/Downloads.

chat.empty: This chat carries on until you start a new one.
chat.partial: Stopped early — this is what it found so far.
chat.interrupted: The connection dropped before the reply finished.

notice.busy: Hermes is busy — sending again in 5 seconds.
notice.expired: That chat is gone on the server. Your next message starts a new one.
notice.approval-failed: Couldn't send your answer to Hermes.
notice.no-key: No API key stored. Close and reopen the card to set it up.
notice.upload-failed: Couldn't copy the file to the server (SSH login in the Orb settings).

chats.title: Your chats
chats.delete_busy: Hermes is still replying in that chat. Stop it, then delete.

offline.title: Can't reach Hermes
offline.text: Check that the server is up and Tailscale is connected.

cmd.title: rename this chat
cmd.footer: Start a message with `//` to send a `/` as text.
cmd.model: pick the model for this chat
cmd.fork: copy this chat and carry on in the copy
cmd.skill: ask Hermes to use one of its skills
cmd.approve: allow what Hermes asked to run
cmd.deny: refuse what Hermes asked to run
cmd.unknown: No command `/{name}`. Type `/help` for the list, or start with `//` to send it as text.
cmd.no_approval: Hermes isn't waiting for an answer.
cmd.no_chat: That needs a chat that has started: send a message first.
cmd.forked: Copied this chat; you're in the copy now.
cmd.model_default: This chat uses Hermes' default model again.
cmd.model_failed: Couldn't get the model list from Hermes.
cmd.model_unknown: No signed-in provider offers `{model}`. `/model` lists them.
cmd.heading: **Commands**
